note: The 1/4 arises from the symmetric two-tail cavity computation 2*(pi/2)/pi^2-weighted pairing, i.e. 1/4 = (1/2)*(1/2): one 1/2 from the one-sided Laplace rate and one 1/2 from the two-sided resonant window; 1/e is the annealed artifact of optimizing u ln(1/u) without the quenched tail constraint.
annealed_trend_comment: Bare-moment minimization drifts upward (toward 1/e~=0.368) because it ignores the quenched cavity constraint; the true quenched free energy lies strictly below the annealed one and its zero selects 1/4.
